main.description: Account deletion (decision J1): delete the mailbox exactly as deleteMailbox does (which also deletes every ORF state), redact every thread item the DID authored (as redactMessages, in every conversation, including remote ones through their sequencer DSes), and delete the DID's idempotency records. MEK records stay, because other members' batches may be sealed under them. Idempotent. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
